title: Ligament
description: A named ligament: a dense fibrous-connective-tissue structure spanning two bones (or a bone and a cartilaginous/capsular structure) that constrains joint motion. Modeled analogously to muscle.schema.json's functional_compartments: many ligaments have documented mechanically-distinct bands/bundles that are taut and slack over different, often reciprocal, parts of a joint's range of motion (e.g. the ACL's anteromedial/posterolateral bundles, the deltoid ligament's four bands, the MCL's superficial/deep layers) rather than acting as one uniform strap -- a ligament with a single homogeneous band still gets exactly one bands[] entry, matching the muscle schema's convention.

joint.description: id of the joint (schema/joint.schema.json) this ligament primarily stabilizes, if it spans a single named joint (omit for structures spanning multiple motion segments, e.g. the anterior longitudinal ligament).

structural_type.description: capsular_thickening: a locally-reinforced part of the joint capsule itself (e.g. glenohumeral ligaments); extracapsular: a discrete structure outside the capsule (e.g. fibular collateral ligament); intracapsular: inside the capsule but extrasynovial or partly synovial-covered (e.g. cruciate ligaments); interosseous: spans a non-synovial interosseous gap (e.g. tibiofibular interosseous ligament, distinct from schema/fascia.schema.json's broader interosseous_membrane sheets); accessory: a supplementary/variable reinforcing band.

attachments.description: Overall span of the ligament as a whole. For a single-band ligament this duplicates the one entry in bands[]; for a multi-band ligament it describes the composite structure's overall footprint.

bands.description: Mechanically/anatomically distinct bands or bundles within this one named ligament. Most ligaments in this atlas have exactly one entry here; multi-band ligaments (ACL, PCL, deltoid ligament, MCL, etc.) enumerate each documented band separately.

mechanical_role.description: primary restraint function, e.g. 'primary restraint to anterior tibial translation'

tension_pattern.description: when in the parent joint's ROM this band is under tension -- ligament bands are frequently reciprocally taut/slack (e.g. ACL's AM bundle tautest in flexion, PL bundle tautest in extension), not uniformly loaded throughout motion.

failure_load_N.description: representative literature ultimate tensile load, where documented (e.g. cadaveric tensile testing studies) -- an illustrative typical value, not a patient-specific measurement (see docs/SOURCES.md's representative-vs-exact-values policy).
